title: Build with Scytáles SDKs
sub: Integrate with Scytáles SDKs, available worldwide, to enhance your product offering and build custom solutions.
featuresHeading: Embrace the Power of Scytáles SDKs for Ultimate Flexibility and Control

features.name: Flexibility
features.body: Experience the flexibility of our extensive SDK library, empowering your software solutions to evolve alongside your changing needs. Scytáles SDKs function as building blocks, allowing you to get only what you need when you need it.

features.name: Time and Cost Efficiency
features.body: Using Scytáles SDKs can save you time and costs associated with building software from scratch or managing on-premises infrastructure.

features.name: Control
features.body: You have more control over the software implementation, allowing seamless integration into existing systems and workflows.

features.name: Performance
features.body: By integrating software through a Scytáles SDK, you can optimize performance, ensuring your applications' smooth and efficient operation.

features.name: Product Ecosystem
features.body: A range of solutions designed to work together.

features.name: Future Updates
features.body: Receive future updates and improvements, ensuring ongoing support and access to new features.

compareHeading: When to opt for Scytáles SDKs
compareLead: Every Scytáles capability ships in more than one shape. Pick the deployment that matches how much you want to own.

rows.label: Best when
cells: You are building your own product and want our capability inside it
You need a working app in market quickly, under our branding or yours
You want the capability run for you, with no infrastructure to keep

sdksLead: Building blocks you can take one at a time. Every SDK below is available on a risk-free 30-day trial.

sdks.name: Scytáles Digital Identity Wallet SDK and Service Manager
sdks.body: The Scytáles Digital Identity Wallet SDK, alongside the Scytáles Service Manager, allows you to create a top-tier ID wallet app that meets stringent security and interoperability criteria and can manage numerous ID credentials and documents.

sdks.name: Scytáles ISO 18013-5 (Part 5) Holder SDK
sdks.body: The Scytáles ISO 18013-5 mID/mDL Holder SDK, accessible for both Android and iOS platforms, allows you to guarantee that your holder app for mobile driving licenses or other mobile IDs aligns with the ISO 18013-5 standard.

sdks.name: Scytáles ISO 18013-5 (Part 5) Mobile Validator SDK
sdks.body: The Scytáles ISO Mobile Validator SDK contains an accredited mobile ID reader for Android and/or iOS to authenticate digital documents adhering to ISO 18013-5 standards, including mobile driving licences.

sdks.name: Scytáles ISO 18013-7 Holder SDK
sdks.body: The Scytáles ISO 18013-7 Holder SDK is a solution for online identity verification on Android and/or iOS, aligned with the ISO 18013-7 (in draft) standard.

sdks.name: Scytáles ISO 18013-7 Reader API
sdks.body: The Scytáles ISO 18013-7 (Part 7) Reader API allows you to authenticate a holder's identity online from an Android and/or iOS device, aligned with the ISO 18013-7 (in draft) standard.

sdks.name: Scytáles ISO MS Windows Desktop Validator SDK
sdks.body: The Scytáles ISO MS Windows Desktop Validator SDK allows you to integrate a certified and interoperable MS Windows ID reader to validate digital documents compliant with ISO 18013-5, such as mobile driving licences.

sdks.name: Scytáles Authenticated Readers Service Manager and Holder SDK
sdks.body: The Scytáles Authenticated Readers Service Manager and Holder SDK provides the ideal solution for managing a fleet of readers requiring authentication and support for the Digital Identity Wallet.

ctaBody: Start on the 30-day trial, then talk to us about the licence that fits. Questions? We're here to help.
